remarks: Discover the space, comfort & peaceful surroundings you’ve been searching for in this beautifully designed Coventry Home. Set on a massive lot of over 750 square metres in the community of Marquis, this stunning BUNGALOW feels bright & welcoming with soaring 10' ceilings & an open-concept design made for connection. The kitchen is the heart of the home with quartz countertops, a tile backsplash, beautiful cabinetry, stainless steel appliances & a pantry. It flows effortlessly into the dining area & cozy living room, where a beautiful fireplace sets the scene for quiet evenings at home. The spacious primary suite offers a large walk-in closet & private 4-piece ensuite with dual sinks, an expansive counter & stand-up shower. A second bedroom, full bath, mudroom & main-floor laundry complete the level. The unfinished basement is ready for your vision. Double attached garage & an amazing ravine nearby. Home is under construction. Photos are not of the actual home. Some finishings may vary. (id:67522)
